People: Pierre Louis Ginguené (author, Wikidata Q1379808), died 1816; Pierre Claude François Daunou (editor, Wikidata Q178991), died 1840. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Ginguené, Pierre Louis, 1748-1816; Daunou, P. C. F. (Pierre Claude François), 1761-1840 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Histoire litteraire d'Italie, par P. L. Ginguene, membre de l'Institut de France... Tome premier neuvieme , 1820, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bub_gb_qtB7wrNO3MsC. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 50%, 82%, 72% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Pierre Claude François Daunou, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
